verdict.rationale: AutoGen documents a UserProxyAgent explicitly built for human-in-the-loop feedback within team workflows (round-robin, swarm), which supports pausing for human input, but the evidence pack lacks detail on resuming mid-run with persisted state/approval decisions or explicit pause/resume APIs beyond the proxy agent turn-taking mechanism. missing for 10: explicit resume-with-state documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of pause/resume mid-run, approval-specific workflow examples.
